q: Which of the following officials are currently serving as Election Commissioners of India along with Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar?
options: Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi
Anup Chandra Pandey and Vivek Joshi
Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Rajiv Kumar
explanation: The Election Commission of India lists Gyanesh Kumar as Chief Election Commissioner, with Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi serving as Election Commissioners.

q: In the context of Indian elections, what does SIR stand for?
explanation: SIR stands for Special Intensive Revision, an intensive exercise related to the revision of electoral rolls.

q: The Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act was enacted in:
explanation: The Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners Act was enacted in 2023 and provides the statutory framework for their appointment and service conditions.

q: Under the 2023 law concerning the appointment of the Chief Election Commissioner and Election Commissioners, who replaced the Chief Justice of India in the selection committee?
options: Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister
explanation: The 2023 law replaced the Chief Justice of India with a Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister in the selection committee.

q: The Election Commission of India is best described as:
options: A statutory authority under the Representation of the People Act
An executive department of the Ministry of Home Affairs
explanation: The Election Commission of India is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of President and Vice-President.

q: Form 6 of the Election Commission of India is primarily associated with:
explanation: Form 6 is used to apply for inclusion of a person's name in the electoral roll, including new voter registration.

q: India recorded Foreign Direct Investment inflows of approximately how much in FY 2025-26?
explanation: India recorded its highest-ever annual FDI inflow of USD 94.53 billion in FY 2025-26.

q: India's cumulative FDI inflow from FY 2014-15 to FY 2025-26 was reported at approximately:
explanation: The cumulative FDI inflow from FY 2014-15 to FY 2025-26 was reported at approximately USD 843 billion.

q: The Make in India initiative was launched on:
explanation: Make in India was launched on 25 September 2014 with the objective of strengthening India as a global manufacturing, design and innovation hub.

q: On 25 September 2026, the Make in India initiative completed:
explanation: Make in India was launched on 25 September 2014 and therefore completed 12 years in September 2026.

q: According to the supplied current-affairs material, the expanded Make in India framework covers how many identified sectors?
explanation: The supplied current-affairs material states that the expanded Make in India framework covers 27 identified sectors across manufacturing and services.

q: The United Forum of Bank Unions announced a nationwide three-day bank strike from:
explanation: The UFBU announced a three-day nationwide bank strike for 28-30 September 2026.

q: The India-Netherlands water-management cooperation mentioned in the current affairs is associated with which Gujarat project?
explanation: The India-Netherlands cooperation through Tripartite MoUs is associated with the Kalpasar Project in Gujarat.

q: Which of the following Dutch organisations were involved in the India-Netherlands cooperation related to the Kalpasar Project?
explanation: The cooperation involved the Netherlands-based organisations Deltares and TU Delft along with Indian institutions.

q: Japan's call at the United Nations concerned the removal of references to:
explanation: Japan called for the deletion of outdated 'enemy state' references from the UN Charter.

q: Roxy Mathew Koll is associated with which institution?
options: Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology, Pune
explanation: Roxy Mathew Koll is a climate researcher associated with the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology in Pune.

q: Which 2026 AGU honour was received by Roxy Mathew Koll according to the supplied current-affairs material?
options: Pavel S. Molchanov Climate Communications Prize
explanation: Roxy Mathew Koll received the Pavel S. Molchanov Climate Communications Prize for contributions to climate communication.

q: PLA, used in biodegradable bioplastics, stands for:
explanation: PLA stands for Polylactic Acid, a bio-based thermoplastic polyester commonly produced using fermentation-derived lactic acid.

q: The PLA-based biodegradable bioplastics initiative mentioned in the current affairs was associated with which policy framework?
explanation: The commercial development of PLA-based biodegradable bioplastics was associated with the BioE3 policy framework.

q: On Day 6 of the 2026 Asian Games, how many medals did India win according to the supplied current-affairs material?
explanation: India won six medals on Day 6: one gold, two silver and three bronze medals.

q: What was India's reported Asian Games 2026 medal tally after Day 6?
explanation: The supplied update gives India's total as 23 medals: 2 gold, 9 silver and 12 bronze.

q: The Haryana Government's Parali Protection Force is primarily aimed at controlling:
explanation: The Parali Protection Force uses measures such as drone surveillance and late-night patrols to combat paddy stubble burning.

q: The Cool Leaders Award was launched under the leadership of:
explanation: The inaugural Cool Leaders Award was launched by the UNEP-led Cool Coalition during the Global Cooling Pledge Assembly in Singapore.

q: The FSSAI proposal concerning analogue products primarily relates to products marketed as:
explanation: FSSAI proposed restrictions concerning non-milk or analogue products being marketed as paneer through draft 2026 amendment regulations.

q: Exercise VARUNA is a bilateral maritime exercise between:
explanation: VARUNA is the bilateral maritime exercise conducted between the Indian Navy and the French Navy.

q: INS Trishul arrived at which French location for Exercise VARUNA 2026?
explanation: INS Trishul arrived at Toulon, France, for the 24th edition of the bilateral maritime exercise VARUNA in September 2026.

q: The long-standing policy target discussed in India regarding public expenditure on education is approximately:
explanation: India has long discussed the goal of increasing public expenditure on education to around 6% of GDP.

q: Which organisation publishes the Travel & Tourism Development Index (TTDI)?
explanation: The World Economic Forum publishes the Travel & Tourism Development Index, which benchmarks conditions and policies supporting sustainable and resilient tourism development.

q: According to the supplied current-affairs update, India ranked ______ in the WEF Travel & Tourism Development Index 2026.
explanation: The supplied current-affairs material reports India at 31st position in the 2026 Travel & Tourism Development Index.

q: What marine animals were rescued after entering shallow waters of the River Thames?
explanation: A pod of 25 pilot whales was guided back to sea after entering shallow waters near Gravesend, Kent.

q: Which company signed the reported title sponsorship agreement with the BCCI for international cricket?
explanation: According to the supplied current-affairs material, Muthoot FinCorp became the title sponsor for BCCI international cricket games until March 2028.

q: The reported BCCI-Muthoot FinCorp title sponsorship agreement was valued at up to:
explanation: The reported value of the BCCI-Muthoot FinCorp sponsorship agreement was up to ₹150 crore, extending until March 2028.

q: Consider the following statements regarding Make in India: 1. It was launched in 2014. 2. It completed 12 years in September 2026. 3. Its focus has expanded towards deeper domestic manufacturing capabilities. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: All three statements are correct. Make in India was launched in 2014, completed 12 years in September 2026, and has evolved towards strengthening domestic manufacturing capabilities.

q: Consider the following pairs: 1. VARUNA - India-France 2. Kalpasar cooperation - India-Netherlands 3. TTDI - World Economic Forum. Which of the above pairs are correctly matched?
explanation: All three pairs are correctly matched. VARUNA is an India-France maritime exercise, Kalpasar cooperation involves India and Dutch institutions, and TTDI is published by the World Economic Forum.

q: Which one of the following combinations is correctly matched?
explanation: SIR correctly stands for Special Intensive Revision. PLA is a bio-based polymer, VARUNA is an India-France maritime exercise, and TTDI is published by the World Economic Forum.
